<h1 class="page-hero__title">FAQ</h1>

<!-- 3. FAQ CONTENT -->
<section class="faq fade-in">
<!-- CHECK-IN & CHECK-OUT -->
<div class="faq__category" id="faq-checkin">
<h2 class="faq__category-title">
<svg></svg>
                Check-in &amp; Check-out
            </h2>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Are there specific days to check-in or check-out? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">You can arrive on any day of the week, so you can find the best flight options.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What time is check-in? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Rooms are ready at 3 PM. Reception is typically open until 6 PM. Late arrivals receive entry instructions.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What time is check-out? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">The room must be empty at 11:00. Any payment must be settled at that time.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Can I pay by card on arrival? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Card payments aren't available on-site, but we can provide a payment link (2% processing fee applies).</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What happens if I book consecutive days of lessons but need to cancel one? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">If you book lessons or rentals across consecutive days and conditions are good enough to run them, those hours must be used on the scheduled days. If you cancel a lesson or rental yourself during that period, the hours are forfeited - they can't be carried over, rescheduled, or refunded.
<br/> <br/>If, on the other hand, we have to cancel because conditions aren't good enough to run the lesson safely, you'll receive a refund or credit for that time.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- KITESURF LESSONS & CAMPS -->
<div class="faq__category" id="faq-kitesurf">
<h2 class="faq__category-title">
<svg></svg>
                Kitesurf Lessons &amp; Camps
            </h2>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What is the best time for wind? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">July and August are the best months due to thermal wind effects during warmer periods.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Do you offer a wind guarantee? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">We don't offer a guarantee, but we average 4 to 5 wind days per week from May to October.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Is this suitable for experienced kiters? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Absolutely. Contact us to discuss what we can offer to match your level.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Do returning students restart from the beginning? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">No. We assess your technique and continue from where you left off.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">How long before I can kite independently? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Timeline varies. Most students get on the board by lesson three, but independent proficiency depends on individual progression.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">How do I book? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">You can book via email or through our contact form. A 30% deposit is required upon confirmation.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What's the cancellation policy? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">100% refund when cancellation is received at least 6 weeks before arrival.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">What is the difference between semi-private (duo/shared) lessons and private lessons? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">In short: semi-private means sharing an instructor, equipment, and kite time with a friend of similar level/weight; private means the instructor and equipment are yours alone, which usually means faster progress.
Semi-private lessons (4 x 3h / 2 students / 1 instructor / 1 set of equipment) are only available if you book together with a friend, and only if:
<br/> - You and your friend are at a similar level
<br/> - You're a similar weight
<br/> <br/>Because we don't have fixed start dates, everyone's schedule and lesson package is different, which makes it very unlikely we'd have a matching stranger to pair you with — so semi-private isn't something we can offer to solo bookings.
<br/><br/>A few things to keep in mind:
<br/> - You're sharing one set of equipment between two students, so the lessons run longer (4 x 3h vs. 3 x 2h for private) to give you both similar time actually on the kite. This works fine for beginners, but if you're close to riding independently, less continuous time with the kite can slow your progress.
<br/> - Progress can vary. Learning alongside a friend is great for motivation, but if one of you progresses faster than the other, it can slow things down or feel frustrating for both.
<br/> - Private lessons (3 x 2h / 1 student / 1 instructor / 1 set of equipment) give you the instructor's full attention and your own equipment for the whole session, with no need to share time or wait for a turn. In our experience, students generally have a faster, smoother learning curve with private lessons.
</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ACCOMMODATION -->
<div class="faq__category" id="faq-accommodation">
<h2 class="faq__category-title">
<svg></svg>
                Accommodation
            </h2>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Do rooms have private bathrooms? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">The bathrooms within the house are all shared.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Are bed linens and towels included? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Yes, bed linens are provided. Beach towels are not included.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Is this suitable for light sleepers? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">We're not a party house. After 23:00, we ask all guests to keep noise to a minimum.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Is this suitable for solo travelers? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Absolutely. Around 50% of our guests travel alone, with average ages in the mid-20s to mid-30s.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- EQUIPMENT & RENTALS -->
<div class="faq__category" id="faq-equipment">
<h2 class="faq__category-title">
<svg></svg>
                Equipment &amp; Rentals
            </h2>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Can I rent equipment without lessons? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">No, we do not rent out gear without lessons for safety reasons.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Should I bring my own gear? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">If you have your own equipment, feel free to bring it. We can store it safely at the lodge.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- GETTING HERE -->
<div class="faq__category" id="faq-getting-here">
<h2 class="faq__category-title">
<svg></svg>
                Getting Here
            </h2>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">Should I rent a car? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">Renting a car gives you a lot of flexibility to explore the region during free time. We recommend it.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="faq__item">
<button class="faq__question">How do I reach the lodge? <svg></svg></button>
<div class="faq__answer"><div class="faq__answer-inner">We're located 90km north of Lisbon, near Lagoa de Obidos. Check our Region page for detailed travel information.</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<h2 class="cta-section__title">Get in Touch</h2>
<p class="cta-section__text">Can't find what you're looking for? Our team is happy to help with any questions about your trip.</p>
